iAm.notice: phase boundaries, parent-linked events, and next seeds

iAm.notice: typed intent, capability, artifact, evidence, and handoff across a boundary

iAm.notice: native MAF executors, messages, checkpoints, pinned-version compatibility, and context limits

iAm.notice: design context and explicit read/draft/publish scope

iAm.notice: action IDs, dry-run parity, command evidence, and exit status
